items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: Old Zut. And Cozy Cole's brother, Ted Cole, and Truck Parham, the bass player, tremendous bass player. And very good band.

ctx.x: Old Zut. And Cozy Cole's brother, Ted Cole, and Truck Parham, the bass player, tremendous bass player. And very good band. And all the musicians, anybody who was anybody would come to the Three Deuces. That all the travelling bands when they came to town, they would -- all the travelling white bands. No black was allowed in the joint at this time. Well, it was very prejudiced -- Chicago was a very prejudiced town, you know. So --
